summary.text: Lisa Baker is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 20 since December 2006 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. Ballotpedia lists Democrat Jaclyn Baker, an educator, as her opponent in a rematch of the 2022 race.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Baker earned a bachelor's degree in government administration from Shippensburg University in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.

Her professional experience includes serving as deputy chief of staff for Republican Governors Mark Schweiker and Tom Ridge, as chief of staff to State Senator Charles Lemmond, and as a research analyst to State Senator Robert C. Jubelirer.
Baker assumed office in the state Senate on December 1, 2006.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her committees as Judiciary, Banking and Insurance, Communications and Technology, Labor and Industry, and Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness.
